title: DeepSeek offers user refunds after suffering another major outage
key_facts: DeepSeek restored its API and Chat Service at 1:04 p.m. Beijing time on Thursday 15 Oct 2026 after an outage that began that morning (8:11 a.m. per BigGo, about 4 hours 52 minutes)
Affected: DeepSeek V4 Pro API, V4.1 Flash API and Chat Service, plus third-party apps relying on DeepSeek
DeepSeek will refund API spending from 8 to 14 October as credit, deposited automatically
It apologised, launched an investigation and said it had reviewed and eliminated single points of dependency; no root cause given
Status page shows eight incidents in September; BigGo counts at least 10 major outages in 2026
Its chat answer said servers 'couldn't handle so many users', reported by BigGo citing China News Service Jingwei
quote_evidence: DeepSeek restored its application programming interface (API) and Chat Service at 1:04 p.m. Beijing Time on Thursday, after an outage that began in the morning.
The notice did not disclose the root cause.
why_it_matters_hint: A major Chinese AI provider's repeated outages hit business users, and it is paying back a week of fees.
notes: SCMP original blocked (HTTP 403); read CGTN and BigGo Finance reports of the same outage and DeepSeek's own notice.
